subtasks: Use the set square to push the three blocks into a straight, aligned row, then reset the robot arm.
Push the long white set square forward along the tabletop with both open grippers behind its near edge, until the three magenta blocks are flush against its far edge. Do not grasp the blocks.
The three blocks are aligned. Leave the set square and blocks undisturbed. Keep both grippers fully open and return both robot arms to their initial home poses.
